value: Short prototype visual novel game by legendary illustrator marusyamo.

You wake up in a daze in the nurse's office after your shrinking examination. A new shrinking drug is being developed, the effects of which are still not quite understood. It affects your body more than others, making you unusually small when you ejaculate. As an anomaly, you have become something of a guinea pig for the drug's development, and are frequently shrunken to various sizes. This time, you've shrunken down to a mere 1.5cm tall.
